// The note is too vague for the agent: nothing changed; the employee edits it or confirms it as is.
return [{ json: { ok: false, unclear: true, score: $json.score, question: $json.question, error: `The note is unclear. ${$json.question} Edit the note, or send it again with confirm_unclear to keep it.` } }];

const d = $('Re-check and execute (mock)').first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'done', note: 'buyer ' + (d.close_buyer || 'n/a'), updated_by: d.update.decided_by } }];

// Mark the plan as being decided so a second click (or a second person) cannot run it twice.
return [{ json: { status: 'deciding' } }];

// Someone else is deciding this plan right now, or it was already decided.
return [{ json: { ok: false, error: `Proposal #${$('Decision webhook').first().json.body.proposal_id} is being decided by someone else or was already decided. Reload the page.` } }];

// Nothing was done: the plan goes back to the state it was in.
return [{ json: { status: $('Get proposal').first().json.status } }];
